messages.subject: on line distance sampling reference list
parts:
Dear List,

This is just a reminder that the web site which keeps a record of=20
references on distance sampling methods, hosted at

http://www.creem.st-and.ac.uk/tiago/webpages/distancesamplingreferences.h=
tml

has just reached the magic number of 1000 references, of which about 1=20
fourth have links to the corresponding pdfs, freely available on the net.

Further, I would take the opportunity to ask all of those who publish=20
in this area to send me a note about the papers you publish on distance=20
sampling issues (methods and applications), so that the list gets=20
updated with minor effort.

All the best,

Tiago
